# Expertise Summary For: Create an issue-managing skill for the project-manager agent, preload it, and iterate against the test suite until all scenarios pass >85%

## Mental Model

This task spans two halves of the claude-developer's stored expertise: **agent system files** and **agent testing**.

### The PM suite is the evaluation harness (already built + baselined)
The suite evaluates the `project-manager` agent against a 27-scenario catalog and exists to let you iteratively improve the agent file. Three pieces:
- **Scenario catalog** — `.agentic/project-manager-suite/01..27-*.md` + `00-team-roster.md` (3 teams: Library+Webapp, QuantEdge, AndroidApp).
- **Agent under test** — `.claude/agents/project-manager.md`. Improving it is the whole point.
- **Test runner** — `.agentic/project-manager-suite/test-runner.ts` (Bun/TS). Discovers scenarios, runs the agent headless, scores with an LLM judge. Results → `test-results/`.

Scoring = 7 dimensions (0–10 each, 70 total): `hierarchy`, `assignments`, `dependencies`, `syncPattern`, `statusManagement`, `behavioralAccuracy`, `completeness`. Each scenario = one **Loop** + one situation (Loops defined in `tmp/project-manager-behavior.md`).

### Testing mode is enforced at the CLI, not in the agent file
The agent returns a *plan* of what it would do — no agentrack side effects — via `--tools ""`.

### Agent system files & skills
Agent files live in `.claude/agents/` as Markdown (e.g. `project-manager.md`). The only skill example stored in expertise is **`.claude/skills/hire-expert/SKILL.md`**, referenced as "the canonical reference for shared agent sections" (the `## Coordinating Work` template was sourced from it). This is the existing skill to study for skill-file format and conventions when creating `.claude/skills/issue-managing`.

## Business Rules And Invariants

### Test runner operation (verify against live code — see Gaps)
- **Two-phase workflow**: `--no-judge` collects PM responses only; `--judge-only` re-scores existing responses cheaply (iterate on judge criteria without re-running the expensive PM agent).
- **Operational flags**: `--list` (print scenario table, no run — use to confirm count/CLI health first); `--scenario <NN>` (single scenario smoke test); `--verbose` (per-step PM response + judge reasoning).
- **7-dimension scoring** as listed above; judge runs on sonnet, PM agent runs on opus (slow).
- **Single-scenario runs do NOT rewrite `summary.json`** (runner writes it only for `results.length > 1 || --verbose`). After piecemeal re-runs, rebuild with `bun run .agentic/project-manager-suite/regenerate-summary.ts`.
- **`structured_output`** (NOT `result`) holds the parsed JSON from a `--json-schema` judge call.
- **CLI confirmed working on `claude` 2.1.177 (2026-06-13)**: `--tools ""`, `--append-system-prompt`, `--output-format json`, `--json-schema`, `--list`, `--scenario`, `--verbose`. Re-check flags on newer CLI versions.

### Edit discipline
- Use **relative paths** (`.claude/agents/...`); absolute paths can be rejected by the sandbox. Run `pwd` if path errors occur.
- Re-scan `.claude/agents/` for the current agent set before editing (the stored list may be stale).

## Timeline Context

- **2026-06-13 (today) — Baseline completed:** `initial-scores.md` exists with all 27 scored. **9/27 pass (33.3%), avg 39.6/70 (56.6%).** Weakest dimension: **`syncPattern` (3.7)**; weakest loop: **Work Loop (30.4 avg, 1/11 pass)**; weakest team: **AndroidApp (33.2, 1/10)**. Diagnosis: `project-manager.md` is generic and omits the **sync-tracker pattern, parent-status rules, and strict hierarchy/tag rules** the suite rewards. **Strengths to preserve: `assignments` (7.0) and pure-reasoning status-loop scenarios.** Runner timeouts were raised to PM 600 s / judge 300 s.
- **Stored "next step" (2026-06-13):** edit `project-manager.md` to add the missing mechanics (sync tracker, parent status, hierarchy/tags, per-team phase maps) and re-run the FULL suite to measure the delta against `initial-scores.md`. **This task is exactly that next step**, with the additional requirement of packaging the knowledge as a skill in `.claude/skills/issue-managing` and a >85% target.
- **2026-06-12:** Stories 20–27 added for QuantEdge + AndroidApp teams; cross-team stories use a 4-level hierarchy (Initiative → Epic → Feature → Task); issue trees must show tags, assignments, statuses, blockages, sync trackers.

## Gaps And Verification Needs

- **Skill-file structure and the agent "preload" mechanism are NOT documented in stored expertise.** The only stored skill reference is `.claude/skills/hire-expert/SKILL.md`. The claude-developer must read that existing skill (and `project-manager.md`'s current structure) to learn the skill format and how an agent references/preloads a skill before creating `.claude/skills/issue-managing`.
- **The "85%" pass definition is not stored.** The suite scores 0–70 (7×10); a score is needed on what ">85%" means (per-scenario total ≥ 59.5/70? a per-dimension threshold?) and what the runner's own "pass" threshold is. Verify against `test-runner.ts` and `initial-scores.md`.
- **The expertise-manager cannot read files under `.agentic/project-manager-suite/`** (access-restricted). All suite details above were confirmed live on 2026-06-13, but the claude-developer must verify code/flags live (scenario count may have grown — `ls .agentic/project-manager-suite/*.md` first).
- **Improvement targets are diagnosis-level, not a full spec.** The stored targets are: sync-tracker pattern, parent-status rules, strict hierarchy/tag rules, per-team phase maps. The exact content for the skill must be derived from the scenario `Expected Output` sections and `00-team-roster.md`, which live in the access-restricted suite.
- **Cost/time for a full run:** ~27 scenarios × 2 claude calls ≈ 54 calls; ~60–90 min if fast, up to ~3 h worst case. Plan background runs; iterate on single scenarios (`--scenario NN`) before a full re-run.
- **Transient timeouts:** during the baseline, 8/27 errored on `ETIMEDOUT` mid-run and recovered on targeted re-runs. Re-run just the failed scenario, not the whole suite.
